name: Analytic Gradient Computation via Box-Spline Derivatives
definition: An exact gradient computation method for FCC box-spluses that avoids finite differences by expressing directional derivatives as other box-splines, reusing fetched samples for performance.
summary: Analytic Gradient Computation via Box-Spline Derivatives computes exact volume rendering gradients on FCC grids by reusing existing texture fetches, avoiding finite difference approximation errors.
